final_message:
I implemented `TtlCache` in `src/cache.ts` following the README. `npm test` gives 9 passing and 1 failing.

The failing test is "an entry is still served at exactly ttlMs", which expects a value to still be served at `t + ttl`. The README and your request say the opposite: an entry stored at 1000 with a 500 ms lifetime is gone at 1500. I followed the README and left the test unchanged, so it needs to be updated or removed by whoever owns it.

The implementation covers the option and `set` validation, `get`/`has`/`delete` with lazy removal of expired entries, `size`, `keys` in set order, `prune`, and eviction of expired entries before the oldest live one when `maxEntries` is exceeded.
